Hebrew computer science topics list. Items starting with English terms (Machine Learning, Data Structures, Operating Systems) rendered LTR. Fixed by replacing detectDir() prefix-based heuristic with full-text character ratio analysis (0.40 RTL threshold, modeled after Google Closure Library).

Hebrew CS theory (Pumping Lemma, Myhill-Nerode). Absolute value pipes |w|, |xy| garbled by BiDi reordering. Tilde equivalence ~_L rendered as plain text instead of math symbol.

Hebrew CS theory (Myhill-Nerode, formal languages) with extensive BiDi math issues. Fixed by restoring the invariant that Hebrew-bearing containers stay RTL and isolating LTR math/regex fragments inside them instead of classifying whole Hebrew paragraphs as LTR.

Hebrew CS theory with regex notation. Asterisks stripped by patchMarkdown() and fixBidiNeutrals() star absorber — (0∪1)*10(0∪1)* lost both asterisks, r₁=(10)* had asterisk relocated into <strong>. Fixed by removing patchMarkdown() and orphaned-star logic entirely; platforms already render markdown to HTML.

Non-Hebrew LIs in RTL lists had asterisks visually displaced by BiDi reordering. r₁: 10 ∈ (10)* showed * before r₁ instead of after (10). Fixed by adding unicode-bidi:plaintext CSS for non-RTL LIs in RTL lists and expanding fixBidiNeutrals() to inject LRM in those elements.

Mixed Hebrew/math text had characters displaced. 'k' in '2k' and Greek Σ rendered in wrong positions due to unicode-bidi:embed splitting LTR runs. Also detectDir() skipped data-aleph-math-isolated spans, misclassifying Hebrew-dominant paragraphs as LTR. Fixed by changing embed to isolate in content.css and removing math-isolated skip from detectDir().
ChatGPT conversation used to verify updated theme selectors (bg-token-bg-primary, sidebar, thread). Confirmed selector matches after DOM changes.

ChatGPT Extended thinking TTFT tracking. detectFirstToken() false-positived on chain-of-thought text inside .markdown p, prematurely clearing data-aleph-thinking. Fixed by querying the last .markdown block (actual response) instead of the first (CoT section). Also removed stale stopGoneCount reference that crashed 120s timeout under strict mode.

Mini-game did not appear on follow-up messages in existing conversations. hasVisibleResponse() used page-global querySelector matching old responses (always true after first message). Fixed by unifying all platforms to use count-based ASSISTANT_SEL detection (snapshot message count at spawn, only check new messages). Also reduced wasThinking poll from 1000ms to 300ms to catch rapid stop-button transitions.

Mini-game dismissed too soon or never on Claude. hasVisibleResponse() count-based check failed because .font-claude-response exists at spawn time (during thinking). Fixed by adding Claude fallback that checks if the response grid gained a 2nd row child (row-start-2 appears only when actual response text starts streaming, not during thinking).

Mini-game should persist after thinking ends. Removes response-visible, stop-button disappearance, and thinking-ended dismissal paths; games should close only via Escape, game over, or win. Pending live persistence verification.

Ending a mini-game (loss/win/ESC) while the assistant was still thinking immediately respawned a new game — gameActive (cleared by dismiss() on every end path) was the only spawn guard. Fixed with a per-cycle spawn latch in the shared trigger (src/mini-game/index.ts + latch.ts): spent at spawn, re-arms only when the USER message count grows past the spawn-time snapshot (count-snapshot pattern from claude-general-002; user bubbles render at send and never mount mid-response, unlike assistant nodes which can appear after spawn and would falsely re-arm). Tolerant of mid-response stop-button flicker and conversation truncation. Caps spawns at one per send across all end paths and all three platforms.

Long Hebrew conversation hard-froze the renderer (main thread saturated for minutes, 100% repro ~10-20s after load): every patchAll() re-scanned the entire conversation (patchBidi hasRTL walks + patchLatex/patchMathText TreeWalker passes), latex DOM writes re-triggered the body observer (the patching flag cannot catch microtask-delivered records), and the 3s/500ms intervals queued passes back-to-back once a pass exceeded the interval. Fixed by per-element/per-message exact-text gates (src/content/rescan.ts wired into bidi.ts/latex.ts), filtering Aleph-authored mutations in the content observer, replacing ul:has(>[data-aleph-rtl]) CSS with the JS-set ul[data-aleph-rtl-list] attribute, gating the tracker settled-recount, and de-quadraticing countFileAttachments; then the scheduler was made fully reactive — no standing 3s/500ms intervals, mutation-scoped passes (120ms debounce + 500ms maxWait), 12ms time-sliced passes with dirty-root re-queue, a self-canceling drain only while streaming-pending/hint work exists, and one 30s attribute heartbeat. Validated: 0 longtasks over 36s settled on the 1012-RTL-element conversation.

Composer feedback loop (c7bb26f): per-editor MutationObserver + uncoalesced rAF/80ms/250ms fan-out wrote dir='auto' onto ProseMirror-managed composer nodes; PM reverted each write (re-render + setSelection/collapse), the observer saw the revert, and the cycle self-sustained at ~300Hz whenever text sat in the composer — even on a 0-message page. Trace: 2,907 rAF fires / 7.5s main-thread in 12.3s, INP 1543ms, 830ms tasks; Grammarly amplified by re-instrumenting per round. Fix: Aleph never writes into contenteditable subtrees — RTL blocks are styled via an Aleph-owned head stylesheet (src/shared/domIds.ts EDITOR_BIDI_STYLE_ID) using scope-attribute + :nth-child selectors (src/content/editorBidi.ts), recomputed from input/compositionend through one coalesced rAF plus a read-compute-compare sync on event passes (string-compare write guard); textarea/input keep direct dir='auto' (no childList feedback possible).
